session_id.Description: Session label as ses-<label>: one row per visit of this participant.

acq_time.Description: When the visit began, in ISO-8601 with its UTC offset: the start of its first run.

target.Description: Anatomical target of the leads at this visit (e.g. STN, GPi, VIM). Kept per visit, because a reimplantation can change it.

left_electrode_model.Description: Left lead model at this visit, as named in schema/electrode_models.json.

right_electrode_model.Description: Right lead model, as named in schema/electrode_models.json. The same as the left when both leads are the same model.

left_ipg_model.Description: Implanted pulse generator driving the left lead at this visit, as named in schema/electrode_models.json or typed. Recorded only: the app does not change any setting from it.

left_ipg_position.Description: Where the IPG driving the left lead is implanted: Left chest, Right chest, Left abdomen or Right abdomen. Empty when not recorded.

right_ipg_model.Description: Implanted pulse generator driving the right lead. The same as the left when one device drives both leads.

right_ipg_position.Description: Where the IPG driving the right lead is implanted, with the values of left_ipg_position. The same as the left when one device drives both leads.
